name: Decommission Protocol
storyline:
The Pillar-series stations were designed to operate for decades in deep orbit. Edith station is no different. Built to study gravitational and atmospheric anomalies above the ice planet of Assaracus, ground control claims the station was abandoned almost exactly a year ago - an unusually long time to sit derelict.

You are a space station engineer working for Ocular systems. You've decommissioned more than a couple Pillar-series stations so this should be no different, but the further you delve into the station, the less the official story makes sense. Why are all the doors locked? Maintenance logs appear recent. The station is crumbling around you.

Something vast has consumed Edith station. Space and time distort as it slowly digests it from the inside out.
summary: Edith station has been abandoned for a year - an unusually long time to sit derelict. You are a space station engineer sent up to decommission the station in a manual service elevator with the ability to stop between floors. Will you discover the truth or simply follow protocol?
